active_hard.title: Integrity outranks style
active_hard.requirement: Never relax an academic-integrity rule to satisfy house style, venue rhetoric, or user preference.

checks.description: Confirm every conflict resolution preserves truth and evidence boundaries.

active_hard.title: No fabricated facts or results
active_hard.requirement: Do not invent facts, experiments, baselines, metrics, p-values, years, venues, trends, error bars, sample sizes, or system components.

checks.description: Trace each factual assertion and artifact value to user-provided or approved evidence.

active_hard.title: Keep internal provenance out of paper prose
active_hard.requirement: Keep local paths, script names, renderer names, DPI checks, placeholder status, and workflow notes out of paper prose and captions.

checks.description: Search paper-facing text for common path, script, renderer, and workflow markers.
Distinguish internal workflow details from scientifically necessary provenance.

active_soft.title: Make figure captions independently readable
active_soft.default: Explain object, scope, encoding, and intended reading without repeating a title inside the figure.
allowed_variants: Keep the caption compact when encoding and scope are conventional.
avoid: captions that merely name the figure
active_soft.report_when: The figure cannot be interpreted without searching the body.
